issues.body: Section 7 says each row is "filed as its own tracked follow-up item" under sq-vrye, but the table supplies no bead IDs and the task database still shows sq-vrye with no dependent child items and only the broad description "publish=false measure-first prototype." Searches for the distinctive P1-P6 work descriptions find no matching beads. This is materially the same unresolved round-1 finding: the document claims independently checkable tracking that does not exist, so the planned isolation gates and correctness/availability hardening can still be lost.
issues.fix_hint: Create actual beads for the independently actionable P1-P6 work (combining tightly coupled rows is acceptable), link them to sq-vrye, and put their IDs in the table. If the beads exist only in an unexported database, export the task state so the committed repository makes the claim verifiable.
issues.title: P1-P6 are still asserted as tracked without identifiable beads

verdict.summary: Round 2 is improving: the native-artifact half of exit condition 3 is now explicitly assigned to P2, and T-GPU-INT is correctly categorized as Tampering. However, the remaining task-tracking defect is still material. Section 7 now asserts that every P1-P6 row is filed as its own tracked follow-up item, but it gives no bead IDs, and the repository task database still contains only the broad sq-vrye bead with no child dependencies or descriptions matching P1-P6. The design record therefore makes a false checkability claim and leaves its concrete deferred security work untracked.
